newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FAN JAILED, BANNED FOR YEAR AFTER ATTACK ON LINESMAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FAN JAILED, BANNED FOR YEAR AFTER ATTACK ON LINESMAN.

text.p: A soccer fan who knocked out a linesman with a bottle of water during a French league match at Lens last week was jailed for a month on Tuesday and banned from all soccer grounds for a year.

The 21-year-old unemployed fan threw the bottle at the official during the second half of Lens' first division match against Paris St Germain on Friday. The match was held up for 10 minutes but the linesman resumed his duties after treatment.
The French League's disciplinary commission is due to meet next week to study the incident and could ban Lens' Bollaert ground for one or more matches.
